subject: Cleanroom purge request: prompts, KV logs, and cache sweep
messages:
From: Danielle Ramos <dramos@cleardevice.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearDevice Legal <legal@cleardevice.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Cleanroom purge request — ClearDevice tenant (scope attached)

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. ClearDevice is asking us to initiate a full purge of generated prompts, assistant outputs, and all KV/index logs associated with our sandbox cleanroom (tenant id: CD-92A). This is tied to an audit requirement and a data-subject-initiated erasure request from one of our test accounts.

Scope (attached): cleanroom_scope_matrix.xlsx — includes the namespaces, short-lived prefixes, and a sample of keys we expect to be removed. The request covers:
- prompt transcripts and generated outputs tied to CD-92A (both persisted prompt logs and any derivative artifacts)
- KV-index snapshots and internal tracing for the cleanroom (last 90 days)
- prefix-based cache/prefetch artifacts (KV caches, batching cache)

Questions for you:
1) Can Redwood confirm the execution plan and provide an estimated start/completion window?
2) What proof artifacts will Redwood provide upon completion (manifests, checksums, signed attestation)?
3) Will there be any disruption to our live production tenants? We want the sandbox isolated and no impact to prod.

Please treat this as a high-priority compliance request. We are flexible on scheduling but would like completion before Dec 3 to align with our audit.

Thanks,
Danielle Ramos
Head of Platform Security
ClearDevice AI

---
Attachment: cleanroom_scope_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet; 12KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Ramos <dramos@cleardevice.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cleanroom purge request — ClearDevice tenant (scope attached)

Hi Danielle —

Thanks for the detail and the scope sheet. We can run the requested purge for tenant CD-92A and provide attestations. High-level plan and quick answers below:

1) Execution plan (summary):
   - Intake & scope verification (T0): confirm exact namespaces and retention windows from your sheet.
   - Quarantine & snapshot (T1): take immutable KV-index snapshot for forensic archive (internal, for 30 days) that will be hashed and stored for audit only.
   - Deletion sweep (T2): run prefix-based deletion across prompt logs, generated outputs, and KV artifacts; flush any in-memory caches used by the cleanroom shard; invalidate relevant model-level prefix caches.
   - Verification & manifest (T3): generate a sweep-manifest (sha256 checksums of deleted manifests, counts) and prepare a signed attestation.

2) Proof artifacts: sweep-manifest-<date>.json (sha256), runbook-purge-v1.3.pdf (ops steps and logs to be retained internally), and a signed attestation email with timestamp and ticket refs.

3) Impact to prod: None anticipated. We will run the purge on the sandbox cluster isolate and use routing policies to keep production shards untouched. If you prefer, we can schedule during a low-traffic window — recommended.

We opened ticket INF-6124 for tracking and will assign ops to start on 2026-11-30 UTC 02:00 (proposed). If that window works for you, please reply to confirm and we will proceed to schedule.

I will loop in Marissa (ops) and Vanessa (customer success) to coordinate the run and delivery.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Note: internal reference INF-6124

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cleanroom purge request — ops plan and runbook attached

Irene / Vanessa —

Following up with an ops-ready plan and the runbook attached. I copied the relevant excerpts below and attached the full runbook (runbook-purge-v1.3.pdf) plus a machine-readable manifest template (sweep-manifest-20261129.json) we'll populate post-run.

--- ops summary ---
Start window (proposed): 2026-11-30 02:00 UTC
Estimated run time: 3-5 hours (sandbox only)
Steps (abridged):
  1) PRECHECK: confirm tenant mapping and current write locks; create immutable snapshots of KV-indexes for CD-92A and store in secure vault (access: audit-only).
  2) PAUSE AGENTS: remove any active ingestion agents for the cleanroom and switch to read-only for the tenant namespace.
  3) SNAPSHOT HASH: compute sha256 for each snapshot and record in temporary manifest (to be included in final proof).
  4) SWEEP: run prefix-based deletion across object stores and prompt logs; remove associated derivative artifacts and truncated cache keys. This includes clearing: prompt log tables (persisted), assistant output artifacts in object store (gz container), KV-index shards matching prefix CD-92A-*, and batching cache entries.
  5) CACHE FLUSH: invalidate in-memory prefix caches on serving nodes and clear KV cache entries.
  6) VERIFICATION: re-run search queries across the sandbox slices to verify zero hits for sample keys from the scope matrix.
  7) MANIFEST & ATTEST: produce sweep-manifest-20261130.json, attach sha256 values, record operator id and run timestamps, and have Legal-signed attestation ready.

Proof items we will deliver: sweep-manifest-20261130.json, operator logs (redacted system identifiers), and a one-page attestation signed by Redwood Legal that confirms deletion actions and timestamps.

Operational notes / safeguards:
- We will not remove any artifacts older than your approved retention unless explicitly listed in the attached scope matrix.
- Snapshots we take for forensic verification will be retained for 30 days in an encrypted archive and only used for audit; they will be hashed and then deleted per policy.
- If we detect dependent objects in shared buckets, we will halt and escalate — no cross-tenant deletions.

Attachments: runbook-purge-v1.3.pdf (ops runbook), sweep-manifest-20261129.json (manifest template)

Please confirm the start window so we can place the run on the calendar and notify ClearDevice. I have a templated completion email below we can use to send the attestations.

--- completion email template (ops -> customer) ---
Subject: Update: Purge complete for ClearDevice tenant CD-92A (INF-6124)
Body: Short summary of actions taken, start/end timestamps, links to sweep-manifest and attestation, and contact for follow-ups.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Operations Engineer — Runtime Reliability
Redwood Inference

2) We need a signed attestation (PDF) that we can archive for the audit — please loop your Legal.

Best,
Danielle Ramos
